exposure.needed: whether the operator's log tooling (grep-style filters, alerts, parsers) matches cert-manager log lines by their previous text format at runtime

consequence.statement: cert-manager keeps working, but some log lines now carry more structured logging information and have changed format, so text-based log filtering or parsing (e.g. grep) that relied on the previous format may no longer match those lines.
consequence.remediation: Review any grep-based filters, alerts, or log parsers that consume cert-manager logs and update them for the new log line format; prefer consuming structured log fields rather than text matching.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, so some log lines have changed format and text-based log filtering such as grep may no longer match them.
